title: TODO: Evaluate XIVAPI offloading opportunities
body:
## TODO — deferred to a future session

Review which XIV Dye Tools features and game-data responsibilities could use XIVAPI instead of maintaining duplicated bundled datasets or lookup logic. This follow-up was requested during the XIVCharaKit dye-name discussion on 2026-10-20.

### Investigation checklist

- [ ] Inventory existing XIVAPI usage across core, api-worker, the web app and bots; distinguish existing integrations from additional opportunities.
- [ ] Evaluate Stain/dye names, localization, color and other sheet-backed metadata, including the current data-generation/update pipeline.
- [ ] Evaluate item names/icons, equipment-model matching, facewear and other game-data lookups where XIVAPI may supply the required fields.
- [ ] Check whether acquisition/vendor information can come from explicit upstream evidence; preserve distinctions between documented facts, inferred availability and missing data.
- [ ] Compare build-time refreshes, optional runtime requests, and a shared cached API-worker integration for each candidate.
- [ ] Assess offline behavior, response time, request volume, upstream availability/limits, caching, cancellation, version/schema pinning, browser access, privacy and source/rights notices.
- [ ] Preserve all supported locales, stable stain/item/facewear identities and migration compatibility; identify any regional or language gaps requiring another source or maintained local data.
- [ ] Identify responsibilities best kept local, including color calculations, matching/indexing, rendering and user-owned collections/presets, rather than assuming an external data API can replace them.

### Expected result of the future session

Produce a short decision matrix for each candidate: current implementation/source, verified XIVAPI capability, proposed responsibility boundary (local, build-time, runtime or cached), fallback behavior, tradeoffs and migration/test requirements. Recommend a bounded first change for separate implementation approval.

Starting point: [XIVAPI sheet-reading documentation](https://v2.xivapi.com/docs/guides/sheets/). The XIVCharaKit investigation verified small Stain-name requests and batched localized responses; broader XIV Dye Tools suitability remains to be investigated.

**Status:** backlog research for a future session. This TODO does not schedule a run, authorize implementation, publish a package or trigger a deployment.
